Validator unreviewed-shape warnings in both Naples dossiers (4 and 3 shapes) are by design, each dossier reviews only its own years.

house-of-savoy ends Feb 1720 (Hague settlement) and kingdom-of-sardinia starts 1721 (Cliopatria row), one-year seam in the ledger/keyframes; kingdom-of-sardinia ends 17 March 1861 where kingdom-of-italy starts.

Cliopatria errors found: Savoy occupied-land gaps in shapes 1691, 1702, 1718; Sardinia 1794 drops Savoy (annexed 1792 on page), 1800 shape keeps Piedmont to 1813, 1859 shape includes Tuscany (annexed 22 March 1860), 1860/1861 south and Marche split does not match the plebiscites, 1734 shape draws occupied Milan; Corsican Republic shapes shifted by a year at both ends; all Napoleonic Naples shapes wrongly include Sicily.

Page disagreements recorded in notes: French occupation of Savoy 1703-13 vs 1704-14; Subalpine Republic page vs Kingdom of Sardinia page on the December 1798 abdication and exile; Parthenopean infobox invasion date 21 January 1799 vs December 1798 text; central Italy referendums 5 March (Sardinia page) vs annexation 22 March 1860 (Unification page, followed).
Unknown-slug counterpart warnings remain until dossiers exist: duchy-of-mantua, united-provinces-of-central-italy, parthenopean-republic.
Capraia (corsican-republic, 2 events) and Capri (kingdom-of-naples-napoleonic, 1 event) resolve to no land cell with --resolve; other regions resolve (La Maddalena widened to a 25 km disc).
